statement: There is no tuple (x_1,...,x_18) in Q^18 satisfying sum_j x_j^2 = 9, sum_j x_j^4 = 27/4, and sum_j x_j^6 = 45/8, with no distinctness, nonzero-coordinate, or interval restriction.
contribution: A full-scope elementary 2-adic disproof: after clearing a primitive common denominator, the three required power sums give incompatible congruences modulo 32. The proof also shows that the earlier nine-unit-circle-pair construction is impossible without any height restriction. No novelty or literature-priority claim is made.
